_note: Image-generation art direction per style (supplied reference data). Merged into src/artstyles/<id>.json by `npm run artstyles`. Keys are ClipForge style ids; sourceId is the id in the original preset set. Optional sd_hint / sd_negative add short colour and layout cues for Stable Diffusion when a style drifts.

style_system.purpose: Apply a selected visual art style to any user prompt without changing its semantic meaning.

application.instruction: Transform only the visual rendering, artistic treatment, materials, textures, colors, lighting and linework according to the selected art style. Do not change the objects, people, characters, actions, locations or meaning described in the original prompt.

auto.name: AI Picks
auto.description: Automatically selects the most suitable visual art style based on the story, characters, environment, mood and target audience.
auto.visual_identity: Adaptive artistic direction with professional composition and visually appealing storytelling.
auto.linework: Automatically selects suitable outlines, edges and detailing.
auto.textures: Automatically selects painting, illustration or digital rendering textures.
auto.characters: Characters must maintain consistent facial features, clothing, proportions and appearance throughout the story.
auto.backgrounds: Selects environments that complement the story and character design.
auto.lighting: Automatically adapts to the scene mood and environment.
auto.composition: Cinematic storytelling composition with clear subject hierarchy.
auto.generation_instructions: Analyze the complete scene description and select an appropriate visual art direction. Maintain visual consistency across all scenes.
auto.negative_prompt: Inconsistent characters, conflicting art styles, poor composition, random colors, distorted anatomy.
auto.prompt_modifier: Choose the most visually appropriate professional illustration style for the subject and context. Create a cohesive, polished image with balanced colors, strong composition, clear visual hierarchy and suitable artistic rendering. Preserve the original subject and scene.
auto.negative_modifier: Inconsistent visual style, poor composition, distorted subjects, visual clutter.

mix.name: Mix All
mix.description: Combines multiple compatible artistic techniques into one creative visual composition.

mix.linework: Combination of clean digital outlines, hand-drawn marks and painterly edges.
mix.textures: Layered paper, watercolor, digital paint, grain, brush strokes and collage textures.
mix.characters: Characters use one consistent primary design language while allowing mixed-media surface treatments.
mix.backgrounds: Can combine painted landscapes, geometric elements, photographic-inspired textures and illustrated environments.
mix.lighting: Expressive lighting with layered highlights and shadows.
mix.composition: Collage-inspired compositions with multiple visual layers and balanced focal points.
mix.generation_instructions: Blend two or more compatible artistic techniques while preserving a coherent visual identity. Avoid making characters look disconnected from their environment.
mix.negative_prompt: Unintentional style clashes, messy collage, excessive textures, inconsistent character rendering, visual clutter.
mix.prompt_modifier: Render using a sophisticated mixed-media art aesthetic combining compatible illustration techniques, painterly textures, layered materials, graphic elements and artistic surface details. Blend techniques harmoniously while maintaining visual coherence and preserving the original subject.
mix.negative_modifier: Chaotic collage, conflicting artistic styles, random textures, excessive visual noise.

rules: Maintain identical facial features across all scenes.
Maintain consistent hairstyle, clothing and accessories.
Preserve body proportions and character age.
Do not randomly change character colors.
Use the same character reference for every generated scene.
Maintain consistent architecture and landscape design.
Preserve the time of day unless the story changes it.
Maintain visual continuity between connected scenes.
Keep background details consistent when revisiting a location.

composition_rules: One clear primary subject per scene.
Use readable foreground, middle ground and background separation.
Ensure characters are fully visible when required.
Keep important story actions visually clear.
